description: This file defines the LookupRefValidations class, which contains static methods for validating numeric input values, specifically integers and positive integers, used within the LookupRef namespace in PhpSpreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: LookupRefValidations
classes.description: Provides static validation methods for numerical reference values used in spreadsheet lookup functions.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates that the input value is numeric and converts it to an integer after flooring. Throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: validatePositiveInt
methods.description: Validates that the input value is a positive integer (or zero if allowed). Throws an exception if validation fails.
